test_docstring_options_disable_signature: test that pybind11 docstring options disable function signatures on bound functions
test_docstring_options_custom_docstring: test that pybind11 docstring options apply a custom docstring to a bound function
test_docstring_options_overloaded_functi: test that pybind11 docstring options handle docstrings on overloaded function definitions
test_docstring_options_enable_signatures: test that pybind11 docstring options enable function signatures with type hints
test_docstring_options_suppress_non_func: test that pybind11 docstring options suppress user-defined docstrings for non-function objects
